page.layout: One page of text in italic verse lines, with marginal notes in the left margin beside the verse. Running head at top centre. Catchword/signature: "Misit" at bottom right, treated as catchword.

p.i: Et Penei qui rura colunt, quorúmque labore
Inde lacessitum primò mare, cùm rudis Argo
Primáque cùm ventis, pelagique furentibus undis
Compositi mortale genus, fatisque per illam
Thessalus ardet ager: reticet pastore fugato
Cede puer facta Patroclus Opunta reliquit,
Exul ab Aemonia Pirenida cessit ad vndam,
Quo duce trabs Colchà sacra cucurrit aqua.
Iunctior Aemonia est Ponto, quàm Romasit Istro.

p.note: Claudianus de raptu Proserpinae lib. 2. Paeneus fl.
p.i: Sic, cùm Thessaliam scopulis inclusa teneret
Arua coli, trifida Neptunus cuspide montes
Impulit aduersos: tum forti saucius ictu

page.notes: Marginal notes are abbreviated and partly cut off at the left edge; their readings are approximate. Heavy damage at the bottom left. Catchword "Misit" is read from the lower right corner.
